from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_outer_packing_master_crud(page: Page):
    # Navigate directly to target master module assuming active session
    page.goto("https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/master/outer-packing")
    
    # Open Add Dialog
    page.click("button:has-text(\"ADD Outer Packing\")")
    page.fill("#outerPacking", "Automated Test Packing")
    page.click("button:has-text(\"Submit\")")
    
    # Search for created entry
    page.fill("input[placeholder=\"Search by Outer Packing\"]", "Automated Test Packing")
    expect(page.locator("table")).to_contain_text("Automated Test Packing")
    
    # Reset Filter
    page.click("button:has-text(\"Reset\")")
